name: ESPHome-like MIDI firmware generator for Raspberry Pi Pico

mentions.name: ESPHome-like MIDI firmware generator for Raspberry Pi Pico
mentions.description: A C++ code generator, inspired by ESPHome, that produces firmware for MIDI devices on the Raspberry Pi Pico from a simple YAML configuration file, enabling firmware for any MIDI device configuration to be generated in seconds instead of hand-programming each device.
mentions.problem: Hand-programming MIDI device firmware is slow and device-specific; the author wanted a generic approach rather than hardcoding a single MIDI hub, so any configuration can be turned into firmware quickly.
mentions.source_excerpt: A cpp code generator like esphome, to generate the firmware for midi devices in a simple yaml file, for raspberry Pico.
